summary: In bad(), the string comparison used the reference-identity operator `==` instead of value comparison, so two equal strings read from input would be reported as not equal. Replaced `string1 == string2` with `string1.equals(string2)` to compare string contents, matching the correct behavior already used in the good branch. Both strings are null-checked before the comparison, so this is safe.
